messages:
sarah_cs: Kicking off FathomAI dedicated pool bring-up. They want steady ~400 req/min, with bursts to ~1200rpm for 10-15m. Need a clear quota plan, runbook, and who owns the surge test.
alex_sre: I can take autoscale policy and runbook steps. Need traffic SLAs (p50/p95) and whether KV/prefix caching will be primed. @diego_eng can you drop load script and priming steps?
diego_eng: Model is rdx-3b-v2, KV cache enabled. Suggested p95 latency <= 250ms. Quick k6 snippet below; will upload full script to S3 and repo. Shadow run first, then ramp:
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://redwood-infer.example/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model: 'rdx-3b-v2', prompt: 'summarize: ...'}), {headers: {'Authorization': 'Bearer $TOKEN'}});
}
```
Priming: 10k prefixes at low QPS for 15m to warm KV. Sampling logs at 1%.
mina_se: I'll run the 30m enablement with customer and own the checklist. Need a canary window ~2 hours after shadow. I'll collect feedback into #cs-feedback and capture notes.
tammy_acct: Heads up finance: bursts over baseline may affect unit cost. If we need a temporary quota bump this month I can route it through billing ops. Also flagged renewal risk = elevated until canary passes.
capacity_bot: Pool allocation request REQ-4321 submitted. Allocation ETA ~4h.
alex_sre: Draft autoscale config:
min_instances: 1
max_instances: 12
scale_metric: gpu_util
target_utilization: 70
scale_up_cooldown_s: 60
scale_down_cooldown_s: 300
burst_headroom: 15%
Fallback: route to rdx-3b-quant when GPU contention >80% to protect p95.
diego_eng: Load test plan: shadow 60m (no traffic shaping), priming 15m, ramp 30m to 1200rpm, hold 15m bursts. Capture tail-latency and error rate. Post-test: run a recovery sweep to validate autoscale down behavior.
sarah_cs: Owners & timeline: sarah_cs (CS lead), alex_sre (ops), diego_eng (eng), mina_se (enablement), tammy_acct (billing). Schedule: Wed 10:00-13:00 shadow + enablement, Wed 14:00-16:00 ramp + canary, go/no-go Thu EOD. :white_check_mark: 
mina_se: I sent calendar invites and the enablement doc. Will post final runbook + S3 script link here when uploaded.
tammy_acct: I'll update CRM and billing queue after canary.
sarah_cs: Please post final runbook, autoscale config, and load artifacts in this thread. Also note any customer concerns during enablement. :rocket:
